target: tracker.sh restore — returns the spec to the status it was shelved from
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: built-thing
status: built
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; tracker_shelve factory/specs/001-a.md me >/dev/null; MID="$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)"; tracker_restore factory/specs/001-a.md me >/dev/null; jq -n --arg mid "$MID" --arg st "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" --arg from "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md shelved_from)" --arg ra "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md restored_at)" '{mid: $mid, st: $st, from: $from, ra: $ra}'
_note: shelved_from must be CLEARED on restore, not left behind: a stale value would let a second restore silently move a spec that was never shelved.
